name: How long does a typical disability remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical disability remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a disability remodeling project depends on its scope and complexity. Minor modifications, like installing grab bars or a raised toilet, might take a day or two. Larger projects, such as a full bathroom renovation for accessibility or installing a ramp system, could take several weeks. Projects requiring structural changes or multiple room modifications will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed project timeline in our proposal after assessing your specific needs and the required work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: minor modifications take days, while larger projects like full bathroom renovations can take several weeks.
